title: Markdown RAG Chunker
description: Turn a document URL or pasted Markdown into header-aware RAG chunks with stable IDs and token counts.

markdown_file.title: Document URL
markdown_file.description: One document per run: the HTTP(S) URL of a PDF, webpage (HTML), Word, Excel, PowerPoint, EPUB, CSV, JSON, XML, Markdown or text file, up to 25 MB. To chunk several documents, start one run per URL. Or kvs://KEY to read a record from the store selected under Key-value store.

markdown_text.title: Markdown text
markdown_text.description: Or paste Markdown directly. Use either this or Document URL; if both are set, choose one with Input mode.

input_mode.title: Input mode
input_mode.description: Optional. Detected automatically from whichever source you fill in; set it only when both Document URL and Markdown text are filled.

source_id.title: Source ID
source_id.description: Optional stable ID for this document, e.g. the page URL when you paste crawled Markdown. It scopes chunk_id, fills each chunk's source, and keys Skip if unchanged, so editing one section keeps the other sections' IDs. Defaults to the Document URL.

kvs_store.title: Key-value store
kvs_store.description: Only for kvs://KEY sources: the key-value store holding the record. The run gets read-only access to this store.

headers_to_split_on.title: Headers to split on
headers_to_split_on.description: Markdown header levels that start a new chunk. ['#', '##', '###'] gives section-level chunks for most documents; deeper headers stay inside their parent section.
headers_to_split_on.sectionDescription: Header-aware splitting first, then a size cap for oversized sections only.

max_chunk_tokens.title: Max chunk size (tokens)
max_chunk_tokens.description: Sections longer than this many tokens are re-split on paragraph, line, sentence and word boundaries with 10% overlap; shorter sections stay whole. 512 suits modern embedding models (OpenAI, Voyage, Cohere, Gemini, Jina, Qwen3); use 256 for short factual lookups and 1024 for long analytical answers. To keep sections whole regardless of size, send null via the API.

tokenizer.title: Tokenizer
tokenizer.description: Encoding used to measure chunks and fill token_count. cl100k_base matches OpenAI text-embedding-3 models; o200k_base matches GPT-4o-era models and counts non-English text more compactly.

strip_headers.title: Move headers to metadata
strip_headers.description: On: header text lives only in each chunk's metadata (best for embeddings). Off: chunks also keep their header line (best for human-readable output).

max_chunk_chars.title: Max chunk size (characters)
max_chunk_chars.description: Optional. Cap chunks by characters instead of tokens; when set, it overrides Max chunk size (tokens).

skip_if_unchanged.title: Skip if unchanged
skip_if_unchanged.description: For scheduled pipelines: when the document and chunking settings match the previous run, nothing is pushed and the run costs only the $0.001 start fee. An unchanged file is not even re-converted. The run Output reports unchanged=true.

cache_namespace.title: Cache namespace
cache_namespace.description: Optional. Keeps Skip if unchanged state separate for pipelines that chunk the same document, e.g. 'dev' and 'prod', so one never skips the other.

max_input_chars.title: Max document size (characters)
max_input_chars.description: Runs whose converted document is longer than this fail fast, before any chunks are billed.

max_chunks.title: Max chunks per run
max_chunks.description: Runs that would produce more chunks fail before pushing any, so you are never billed for a runaway split.

use_apify_proxy.title: Use Apify Proxy
use_apify_proxy.description: Download the document through Apify Proxy (datacenter) when a site blocks direct requests. Included in the price.

proxy_url.title: Custom proxy URL
proxy_url.description: Or use your own proxy: http://user:pass@host:8080, https://host:8080 or socks5://host:1080. Stored encrypted. Not combinable with Use Apify Proxy.
